metadata.title: Security Assessment Results - Secure Identity Provider (Active Directory ad.utoronto.ca)
metadata.remarks: Security Assessment Results for the Active Directory instance ad.utoronto.ca, evaluating its identity assurance posture and its role as an upstream federated identity provider to Microsoft Entra ID.

findings.title: Limited Native Breached Password Detection
findings.description: Native on-premises Active Directory does not provide built-in breached password detection or credential compromise prevention. Reliance on password length and complexity alone provides limited resistance to modern credential stuffing and password reuse attacks.

associated-risk.title: Increased Risk of Credential Compromise
associated-risk.description: Lack of breached password detection increases exposure to account takeover via reused or compromised passwords.

findings.title: Dependence on External MFA and Federation for Strong Authentication
findings.description: Active Directory does not natively enforce multi-factor authentication. Strong authentication assurance is achieved through external MFA systems and federation (e.g., DUO via ADFS/Shibboleth), extending the identity trust chain beyond the directory itself.

associated-risk.title: Extended Authentication Trust Chain
associated-risk.description: Authentication assurance depends on the availability, configuration, and security of external federation and MFA components.

findings.title: Limited Native Identity Risk Detection
findings.description: Active Directory provides authentication and directory events but lacks native identity risk scoring, anomaly detection, and automated compromise signaling. Advanced identity threat detection requires supplemental tooling.

associated-risk.title: Reduced Visibility into Identity Compromise
associated-risk.description: Limited native risk detection may delay identification of compromised or abused accounts.

remediations.title: Enhance Password Compromise Protection
remediations.description: Supplement Active Directory password policies with breached password detection and modern credential hygiene controls.

tasks.title: Deploy Breached Password Detection
tasks.description: Implement Azure AD Password Protection for on-premises Active Directory or equivalent breached-password detection mechanisms.

remediations.title: Reduce and Harden Federation Dependencies
remediations.description: Preserve or improve authentication assurance by simplifying federation paths and increasing reliance on native Entra ID identity protection where appropriate.

tasks.title: Align Federation with Entra ID Assurance
tasks.description: Review ADFS and Shibboleth federation configurations and migrate applicable authentication flows toward native Entra ID MFA and risk-based controls.

remediations.title: Improve Identity Threat Detection for AD
remediations.description: Increase visibility into identity compromise through identity threat monitoring tools and correlation with downstream IdPs.

tasks.title: Integrate Identity Threat Detection
tasks.description: Deploy identity threat detection solutions (e.g., Defender for Identity) and integrate signals with SIEM and Entra ID Identity Protection.
